basic_details.job_title: SGPGIMS Post Doctoral Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Walkin for 10 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Sanjay Gandhi Postgraduate Institute of Medical Sciences, Lucknow (SGPGIMS) has announced 10 vacancies for the Post Doctoral Fellow post, covering specialties including Pediatric CVTS, Minimally Invasive CVTS, Skull Base and Spine Surgery, Neuro Endoscopy, Neurophysiology, Neuro Critical Care, Renal Transplantation surgery, Pediatric Urology, and Uro-Oncology. This engagement is on a contract basis for a one-year appointment with Lucknow as the place of posting. content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The institute has invited applications for 10 vacant Post Doctoral Fellow (PDF) posts across four major departments and various specialties. The number of posts may be increased or decreased.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for SGPGIMS Post Doctoral Fellow
content_sections.text: Download or obtain the prescribed format of the application form from the official website. Fill out the application form with the required details. Attach the required Application Fee and scanned copies of all necessary documents. Email the scanned copy of all documents and application details to the Executive registrar officer at [email protected] . Send the physical application form along with the required Application Fee and documents through Speed Post to the Executive Registrar, Sanjay Gandhi Postgraduate Institute of Medical Sciences (SGPGIMS), Raebareli road, Lucknow-226014.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection process involves a walk-in interview scheduled for 30 October 2026 (Friday) at the School of Telemedicine, Ground Floor, SGPGIMS, Lucknow. Candidates must first attend Document Verification at the office of the department concerned from 10.30 hrs to 13.30 hrs, followed by the walk-in interview from 14.00 hrs to 16.00 hrs.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The number of posts may be increased or decreased. No TA/DA will be paid to candidates for attending the interview. Candidates must complete document verification at the concerned department office before attending the interview. Applications must be sent via Speed Post to the institute address and scanned copies must be emailed to [email protected] .

faq.question: Q1. What is SGPGIMS Post Doctoral Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: It is a one-year appointment recruitment drive conducted by Sanjay Gandhi Postgraduate Institute of Medical Sciences, Lucknow, for 10 Post Doctoral Fellow vacancies across various surgical and medical specialties.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in SGPGIMS Post Doctoral Fellow recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 10 vacant seats announced for various specialties under Cardiovascular & Thoracic Surgery, Neurosurgery, Neurology, and Urology departments.

faq.question: Q3. What is the date of the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to be held on 30 October 2026 (Friday).

faq.question: Q4. Where will the walk-in interview take place?
faq.answer: The interview will take place at the School of Telemedicine, Ground Floor, SGPGIMS, Lucknow.

faq.question: Q5. What are the timings for document verification and the interview?
faq.answer: Document verification takes place from 10.30 hrs to 13.30 hrs at the office of the department concerned, and the walk-in interview is held from 14.00 hrs to 16.00 hrs.

faq.question: Q6. How should candidates submit their application forms?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit their application forms on the prescribed format along with the application fee and required documents through Speed Post to the Executive Registrar, SGPGIMS, Lucknow, and also send a scanned copy via email to [email protected].

faq.question: Q7. Is any TA/DA paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No TA/DA will be paid to the candidates for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the duration of the Post Doctoral Fellow appointment?
faq.answer: The appointment is for a duration of one year.
